env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds and deploys the RT-CV person-detection delta on the current `search` developer profile. The build label `in-2-runtime` is directory metadata only. Detection events must reach Kafka topic `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch; streamed and uploaded media must remain retrievable through VIOS.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build and deploy under `_builds/in-2-runtime/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand person detection and multi-object tracking with RT-DETR on RT-CV. Preserve VIOS playback. Publish bounding boxes, labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs to Kafka and Elasticsearch." Target `{{platform}}`. Exclude embeddings, Search analytics/API, Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, RT-VLM, and LLM inference. Validate before deployment, prove live and uploaded paths, and leave services running for verifier probes.
checks: `_builds/in-2-runtime/override.env` exists with `FOUNDATION=search`, the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only customized environment values.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`; all explicitly excluded capability keys, including `rtvi-vlm`, are absent.
`ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is effective because VLM critique was excluded.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains only current canonical profile keys and contains no build label or invented aggregate profile.
`_builds/in-2-runtime/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, and `patches/` is absent because no service definition changes are required.

The build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Resolution uses the ordered `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and build `override.env` layers with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, contains no service profile gates, real unresolved `${...}` interpolation, `/path/to/deploy/docker`, or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.
Deployment uses exactly `_builds/in-2-runtime/resolved.yml` without re-reading Foundation env files or supplying a profile flag.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200, and RT-CV reports the requested RT-DETR/person configuration.
An uploaded warehouse video is retrievable through VIOS playback or clip APIs.
A live NvStreamer source is registered with VIOS and RT-CV is driven from the actual VIOS live-proxy RTSP URL discovered at runtime.
Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets are recorded before and after live processing and increase.
Elasticsearch contains RT-CV metadata attributable to the processed sensor, including the requested detection/tracking fields.
No file under `deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Foundation, effective delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka, and Elasticsearch evidence.
